hero.heading: Everything I've built for Renoise
hero.lede: Instruments, colour themes and the tooling behind them. All of it is Renoise-native: the sampler, the LFOs and the macros already in the box, no plugins to install. The counts and dates below are pulled from GitHub when the page is built.

sections.title: Sound
sections.blurb: Instrument libraries that go straight into User Library/Instruments/, plus the LFO shapes behind them.

sections.title: Tools
sections.blurb: The machines that make the libraries, usable from a browser, a terminal, or inside Renoise.

sections.title: Themes
sections.blurb: Colour themes for the tracker, live previews, and the notes on what makes one work.

sections.title: Archives
sections.blurb: Things that existed in chat or on forums and would otherwise be gone.

renoise-wavetable-instruments.name: Wavetable instrument library
renoise-wavetable-instruments.blurb: 2,346 gate-scan instruments filed by timbre, built from CC0 wavetables. One sample slot per frame, one gate LFO per slot, and a WT Position macro that walks the table while a note holds.

renoise-trove.name: Renoise Trove
renoise-trove.blurb: A vault of native instruments and phrases under CC0, gathered so they stop being scattered across forum posts and chats.

renoise-wavetable-tools.name: Wavetable builder
renoise-wavetable-tools.blurb: Turns wavetables into gate-scan instruments three ways: a browser page that runs the whole conversion client-side, a Python CLI for whole collections, and a Lua tool that builds from samples already inside your song. The XML it writes is validated against the schema Renoise ships.

renoise-forum-color-themes.name: Forum colour theme archive
renoise-forum-color-themes.blurb: Every theme posted in the Color Themes For Renoise thread from 2006 onward, with a gallery that previews each one against real tracker screenshots, a catalog, and a shell installer for the whole set.

renoise-theme-collection.name: My own theme collection
renoise-theme-collection.blurb: The themes I use and maintain myself, ported from the palettes I liked elsewhere: Everforest, Gruvbox and friends, plus some originals.

renoise-theme-design-principles.name: Theme design principles
renoise-theme-design-principles.blurb: Notes on what a tracker theme has to get right — contrast between pattern data and chrome, keeping hue noise out of the pattern area, and why some palettes are unreadable at 3 a.m.

renoise-themes.name: Theme platform
renoise-themes.blurb: The web app behind renoisethemes.com: upload an .xrnc and it generates a palette, applies the theme to live tracker screenshots, and tags it by mood and colour family. The domain is parked while I decide what happens to it.

renoise-community-archive.name: Community server archive
renoise-community-archive.blurb: Renoise-native files shared in the community Discord, pulled out before the attachment links expired: tools, instruments, songs and device chains, with the full attachment index. Read from 64,172 messages across 25 channels.

lfo-shapes.name: LFO shapes and modulation sets
lfo-shapes.blurb: 133 LFO shape presets and 133 sampler modulation sets, pulled out of Vital's LFO tables and rebuilt as Renoise-native files. They sit in the wavetable builder repository, ready to copy into your user library.

footer.line: Built and measured from the machine that made the files. Page generated by build.py from data.json plus live repository facts.
